task_scope: FactoryBench L1-L3 manufacturing telemetry tasks using time-series sensor streams and item-specific output contracts

failure_taxonomy.description: One scalar numeric prediction item was incorrect, but other scalar items were correct and the development evidence does not support a reusable calculation rule without risking case-specific overfitting.
One four-letter T/F item produced an empty output, while another four-letter T/F item was parsed and scored correctly; this is an isolated output failure rather than a recurring format mechanism.

fallback_policy: Use the original item-specific task specification and output contract exactly.
predicted_regression_risks: A broad formatting reminder could interfere with already-correct scalar, MCQ, and T/F outputs.
A procedural rule for numeric prediction could overfit a single failed scalar case and harm correct scalar-range behavior.
A rule specialized to post-event Boolean telemetry could disturb a previously correct four-letter T/F response because development evidence is inconsistent.
evidence_limitations: Only six development items are available across two folds.
Observed failures are isolated by format and fold rather than recurring across folds.
No adapter-v1 results are available for comparison.
The development set contains mixed datasets, levels, formats, and task types, limiting support for a narrow reusable adapter.
